text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Sis. I'm truly grateful to 
be able to congratulate you in person like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In your case, there are plenty of times 
where one can't even send you a message, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Was that how it went...? Regardless, thank 
you. By the way—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I received the birthday gift you sent. An 
unusually heavy pen, some wire... Quite a 
menacing assortment, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Dangerous? Nonsense... It is merely a 
crime prevention toolkit prepared for 
worst-case scenarios.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From what I've heard, you tend to get 
mixed up in trouble quite easily while 
traveling. So, I've put together a few 
portable items for you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see. Indeed, it's not without its risks, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame, but I'll probably leave most 
of it behind. I like to travel light, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand. Well, I have a backup 
plan, so please allow me to give you a 
present another time."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... I'll take that one. The 
golden safety charm.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
With that, you can hang it from your 
backpack. Even so... it's probably the 
heaviest one, though.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...If you understand that much, then I am 
glad."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please take care... and stay 
safe.
